claims.statement: Tom Allen sparred Joe Coburn at Mozart Hall; Coburn was the more active and landed about twice as many blows.
claims.excerpt: In sparring Coburn appeared to be more active and expert than Allen, and got in fully twice as many blows as the latter

claims.statement: Deposits for a match between George Seddons and Johnny Lafferty were to be made at Tom Allen's saloon in St. Louis.
